rules.text: Returns made within 30 days of the order delivery date will be issued a refund to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Returns made within 30 days of the order delivery date will be issued a refund to the original form of payment.

rules.text: Furniture quality defects may be returned for a refund within one year from the purchase date.
rules.quote: We guarantee the quality of our furniture (free of manufacture defect) for up to one year from purchase. If you experience any defects, you may return your furniture purchase for a refund within one year from the purchase date.

rules.text: Most furniture items may be returned or exchanged by carrier within 30 days from the date of delivery.
rules.quote: Most UO Furniture items may be returned or exchanged by carrier within 30 days from the date of delivery.

rules.text: After one year, no returns or exchanges will be accepted.
rules.quote: After one year, we will no longer accept returns or exchanges.

rules.text: Purchases made from 10/1/2026 to 12/24/2026 may be returned for a refund through 1/31/2027.
rules.quote: Purchases made from 10/1/2026 to 12/24/2026 may be returned for a refund to the original form of payment through 1/31/2027.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that refunds are to the original form of payment, which is specified in the quote.

rules.text: A $5 restocking fee will be deducted from your refund for most mailed returns.
rules.quote: A $5 restocking fee will be deducted from your refund for most mailed returns.

rules.text: Select furniture items are subject to a 15% restocking fee if returned, plus applicable taxes.
rules.quote: Select furniture items are subject to a 15% restocking fee if returned, plus applicable taxes.

rules.text: Made-to-order furniture, sale items with additional sale-on-sale discount, and items ending in $0.95 are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
rules.quote: Some items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. This includes made-to-order furniture, sale items purchased at an additional sale-on-sale discount, and furthered sale items ending in $0.95.

rules.text: UO MRKT items must be returned to the seller and cannot be returned to Urban Outfitters or UO stores.
rules.quote: Eligible UO MRKT items must be returned to the UO MRKT seller and cannot be returned to UrbanOutfitters.com or UO stores.

rules.text: Returns without a receipt will not be accepted.
rules.quote: Returns without a receipt will not be accepted.

rules.text: Returns within 30 days of delivery will be refunded to the original payment method; returns after 30 days will be refunded via emailed e-merchandise credit.
rules.quote: Returns Within 30 Days of Delivery: The original method of payment will be refunded in full. Returns After 30 Days of Delivery or a Gift Return: A UO Gift Card will be issued for the price paid.
rules.reviewNote: The summary says refunds after 30 days are via emailed e-merchandise credit, but the quote specifies a UO Gift Card, not necessarily emailed or e-merchandise credit.

rules.text: Refunds take approximately 1-2 weeks for processing plus 1-3 business days to credit back to the original payment method.
rules.quote: Please allow approximately 1-2 weeks for return processing. You will receive a refund notification from us when your return has been processed, and refunds will take an additional 1-3 business days to credit back to your original form of payment.
